balls.text: yorker on the stumps, driven firmly down to long on for one

another one, this one off the slower ball, and he's tonked it to the same area for a massive six! He waited for the ball that was outside off and powered it deep into the stands to the wide long on boundary
it's full, Reddy spotted the marginal error in length and heaved it to the cow corner boundary for a clean six
yorker well outside off, he digs it out towards mid off for one

block hole it is on the stumps, he's fallen over and the stumps have been rattled! He shuffled across well outside off and tried to paddle the ball fine but got an inside edge and the ball got the base of middle stump
in the block hole around off, Moises blocks and gets an inside edge onto his pads
Moises also makes room, Anureet responds with a full toss now, but he doesn't middle it and collects one towards long on
another attempted yorker that can't be put away, Reddy pushes the ball by making room and gets one to long on
extremely low full toss, almost a yorker, and it's pushed down to long on
falls safe as Reddy makes room for the full delivery, chips it high into the covers but it falls wide of Marsh at extra cover
almost another yorker on middle stump, driven down to long off now
tries a yorker on leg stump, he blocks it back
tries the yorker as Moises makes room and steers the ball to deep square leg for one
slower ball on the stumps, Reddy chips it high this time by driving the ball early, Dhawan dives for the ball from mid off but it's out of his reach
full on the stumps, Reddy chips it just over mid off by making some room and clears the fielder to get four
short of length outside off, guides it late to third man and they come back quickly for two
edged again, and this time straight to the keeper! This was short at 135kmh, closer to the batsman as he tried to nudge it over the keeper but only handed Saha a simple catch to his right
slower ball angled across outside off, he edges it late and it goes to the keeper after a bounce
walks down the track but is only able to knock it back to the bowler
fuller on the stumps, turned to deep midwicket, they go for the second, non-striker puts in the dive
it is difficult to go after Axar, Ojha tries swinging this with the incoming angle over long-on, fails to clear the fielder, he takes it some way inside the boundary
flat and slanted in, he comes down the track but cannot do much with it, forces it to extra cover
wasn't to the pitch as he charged out, but connected as he swung nevertheless, and lifted the ball over the non-striker
gets the yorker in around leg stump as batsman makes room, he can only dig it out
short ball into the body, he swivels and pulls it into the ground, to short fine leg's left
slow bouncer outside off, he hops and tries to cut, misses
keeps it full just outside off, but Ojha stays beside the line and slices it hard to the sweeper's right
full delivery squeezed to extra cover, Miller goes for the non-striker's stumps, Henriques was gone had he hit
definite chance this, tough one, he clears front leg and hammers a full delivery back to Anureet, bursts out of his hands
was that a chance, it was slammed back to the bowler's left, he dived and got his hands to it, but it slipped down the ground
stays back and swats a shortish one to deep midwicket
got close to the pitch as Axar gave it slight air, but could not hit it clear of long off
skidding on flat close to off, he tries a cut and chops it into the ground
again not able to get under the ball as Axar slants it in flat and quick, pushed to extra cover
charges out and heaves, only manages to hit it back to the bowler
turned wide of Sandeep at fine leg
good length ball, around off, defended tightly to extra cover
dug in short, but leg sidish again, he cannot get hold of the pull, mishits it tamely behind square
that got big on him and came back in too, but he handled it reasonably well, gliding it down to third man
pitched up but down the pad, and flicked down to long leg
leading edge, but well in front of extra cover, as Ojha looks to work a shortish ball to the leg side
slower ball well outside off, chipped in the air through the covers to long off for one
touch short of length around off, swatted to midwicket
shorter ball now, pulled behind square to fine leg for one

nearly a run out! The shortish ball was pulled from outside off, Bailey stopped it at midwicket as Moises came halfway down the pitch. Bailey first tried to throw with his right arm, but then switched and threw to the keeper's end with his left
slightly wider outside off and it's pushed wide of cover for one
ingswing from just outside off, Ojha chips it into the covers by checking his shot but it falls wide of mid off and right in the gap for four
wide and full delivery, it's steered to the point boundary where the ball is cut off inside but they settle only for one
full delivery is driven firmly to cover where another fumble concedes a single
short ball towards the batsman, pulled behind square to fine leg for one
beaten this time! Shorter and slightly wider outside off, Ojha looked to cut it to third man but could not connect
wider outside the off stump, helped to point where there's a fumble
back of length around off, helps it late to point
doesn't move much and waits for the ball before pushing it down to long on
towards leg stump now, tucked towards deep square leg and there's time only for one
turning a bit towards middle and leg, helped to deep midwicket
width outside off with some flight, driven firmly to deep cover for one
pushes the ball from outside off with the turn down to long on
slow and flighted on middle stump, comes down and tucks it to deep square leg
fullish outside off, driven straight to cover
the big wicket has fallen - Warner holes out to long on! He came down the track and whipped the ball from leg stump in the air down the ground and Miller took a good catch while running in
comes down to drive the fullish delivery with a straight bat to long off
angled in towards middle and leg, tucked to midwicket
full and bit of flight, hammered down past the bowler to long off
goes behind square again, four this time! Got a shortish delivery outside leg, he went down on a knee and paddled it fine down leg for four
cuts the shorter delivery outside off, tries to beat short third man but he dives to his right to save a few runs
comes down and pushes the ball to long off by taking it on the full
slices this one towards point off the back foot for one
much shorter outside off, cuts it late but straight to short third man
that's a full toss well outside off and he frees his arms to drive it to sweeper cover to bring up his fifty
full and flighted outside off, driven firmly to cover
flighted and low on the pads, flicked down to long on for one
tries to pull the shortish ball to leg, gets a bottom edge towards the leg side
on length outside off, driven down easily to long off for one
much shorter on middle stump, jabbed to deep midwicket for one
beaten through the air as Warner came down the track, Axar pitched it slow and short and Warner couldn't put it away
fullish around off, Moises makes room and drives powerfully to cover where a misfield concedes one
keeps low as it turns towards middle stump, Moises helps it to long on for one
shorter and flatter on middle and off, Warner goes back and tucks it to long on for one
full and turning in from middle, driven down to long on for one
flighted and nearly in the block hole well outside off, he digs it out to deep point for one
full on the stumps, Warner pushes it back to the bowler
turning into the batsman, he goes back and tucks it to leg for one
the slower ball foxes him! It was short and slightly wide outside off, Vihari pulled the ball early and it went high towards square leg for an easy catch to be taken near the umpire
he stands tall and lofts it straight down the ground over the umpire's head for four and poses for the photographer! Length delivery, driven down through the air and beautifully executed
straighter delivery on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
towards the pads now, it deflects off the legs or a leg bye towards midwicket
wider and shorter outside off, he slices it to third man for one
127kph, it's Vihari's turn now, driven for four! Length delivery outside off, Vihari leaned forward outside off and punched it between cover and mid off t send it racing for four
errs with the length now, bit too short and Warner stays back to slap-pull it, with not much power but timing, past midwicket for the fourth four of the over
changes the length now. Good length delivery on middle stump, Warner defends it on off
pitched up and driven again, third four of the over! Similar length he's been bowling all along and Warner is ready for it. He crunches it through the covers again
lofted down the ground, it's from the toe end of the bat but he's got enough to send it away for four right over the bowler's head
fullish again around off, Warner drives this one straight to cover point
tries the yorker on off stump, Warner pounces on it and drives handsomely past short cover for another four nobody can think of chasing
short ball angled across the batsman at good pace, Vihari tries to ramp the ball over the slips but misses
short on middle and leg, Vihari doesn't move much and nearly hands a catch back to Johnson
short ball, Warner pulls and gets a bottom edge towards midwicket for a quick single

for a second it looked like Warner somehow defended it to save his off stump, then it raced away for four! The ball nipped in slightly and Warner played outside the line but he pushed it down and it beat mid on for four

top-edge for six in the third man region! He made room by moving on the on side, Mitch pitched it short outside off and Warner threw his bat at it to get a top edge fine towards third man to send it all the way
swishes at it outside off by making some room and hammers it through the covers for four! He opened up for the length delivery outside off and crunched it for four
draws an outside edge as Warner looks to push the ball back from middle stump but thick edge goes to third man for one
right on target on middle stump, Warner defends it back off the back foot
caresses that through the covers with a gentle drive, not a big follow through. Length delivery outside off and Warner timed it perfectly to beat mid off
slightly back of length outside off, Warner punches it into the covers and Axar dives to his right to stop it
accurate delivery on leg stump with some swing, driven to mid on again
fullish on the pads, pushed down to mid on
length delivery outside off with the angle at good pace, Vihari pokes hesitatingly but keeps his bat well inside the line

Johnson strikes early, gets Dhawan off the edge at slip! This was not the typical Dhawan dismissal outside off, he pulled the short ball from around off, got an edge that hit his shoulder and helmet and looped towards first slip where Vijay took a simple catch
pushes the full delivery on the pads towards midwicket for one
much better from Warner, just chips it over the covers for four this time! It was towards middle stump, Warner drove it inside out uppishly in the air but cleared the field

thick edge over first slip, goes for four! Warner made room and came down for Johnson, threw his bat for the short ball outside off and got a thick edge that flew right over the lone slip for a one-bounce for
pitched up slightly outside off, it's pushed into the covers for a quick single and Bailey has a shy at non-striker's end but Dhawan makes it
even better outswinger as Warner is beaten completely! He looked to defend the ball without any footwork and the ball shaped away beautifully to beat the outside edge
loud appeal with beautiful outswing as Warner is trapped in front of leg stump but that one pitched outside leg
good outswing this time outside off as Warner leans forward to push it to cover
goes back this time for the shorter delivery and punches the ball to cover point
draws a thick outside edge as Warner presents a straight bat and the ball swings out to go to the off side
hint of swing outside off as Warner pushes the length delivery down towards mid off
this has been a match of block holes, that's how it finishes as Johnson steers this one to long on and takes one to end the match
on the off stump, in the block hole and Sandeep digs it out on off for one
creates some room and tonks the ball to wide long on for one
Warner can't let the ball go, he just can't! Anureet lofted the low full toss high in the air down the ground and Warner ran in to complete a very good low catch
makes room again and connects this time to find a single to mid on
makes room for the big hit, PK chases him with a yorker and he's hit on the pads
Ojha appeals alone this time, not given for the caught behind as Anureet swishes at the ball outside off and misses
swinging yorker towards the stumps now, appeal from Bhuvi for lbw and he's given! Dhawan tried to paddle the ball on the leg side, didn't connect and was hit low and in front of off stump
swinging yorker outside leg as Johnson makes room, but there's no room and he gets an inside edge on the leg side for one
low full toss on the off stump, smashes it straight to cover
in the block hole just outside off, Dhawan makes room to drive on off but misses
appeal for lbw as he tries to paddle the full ball from just outside off, but he misses and is hit on the back knee, somehow crosses for the leg bye

another miscued pull from Saha, this time he's gone by giving a simple catch to square leg for PK. But they're checking for the no ball, hang on. Looks like Boult's heel has landed just on the line, I don't think there's anything behind it. Third umpire taking his time, trying different angles. From the stump cam near the umpire it seems something was indeed behind the line, maybe. Given out!

Boult tries the block hole outside off, Saha replies with an awkward paddle and misses it but the ball deflects off his right leg from outside off to go fine down leg for four. Singalled as runs off the bat
slower ball angled in, pulled with some power to deep midwicket
almost a yorker outside off, Dhawan makes room but misses the ball

that's a well-connected and firm cover drive right in the gap but Warner races across from long off, slides in no time and picks the ball up with only his left hand and throws it back in no time. Excellent effort
the sound of the ball crashing into the stumps, followed by silence in the ground! Axar makes room to smash the ball, it's right in the block hole at good pace and it rattles the stumps
126kph, slightly slower yorker on the stumps, Axar watches carefully and pushes it down to long on for one
slow yorker, Saha pushes it just past the bowler for one to long off
pulls this one on the other side, it's in the air and in the gap for two before Bopara cuts it off at deep midwicket
another attempted yorker, Saha takes it as a full toss by making room and scoops it over the covers for four. The crowd erupts
tries the block hole on middle stump, Axar heaves it along the ground to deep midwicket
angles in a yorker, Axar steers it wide of deep midwicket in the gap for two
Saha finally middles a short ball and middles so well it's gone for six! It was angled into hime, he swivelled on the back foot and tonked it over deep square leg for six. The crowd comes alive
136kph, in the block hole outside off, Saha makes room to smash it and misses
charges down, swings his arms freely on the off side and finds deep cover only for one
slower ball on outside off, he tries to sweep to leg but manages an inside edge and gets one on off
shot ball is pulled to deep midwicket in the gap for two

that's gone very high, very very high and a mix-up between Boult and the keeper means Boult tries in the end and it goes through his hands. Saha pulled, found a top edge and that went behind the stumps on the off side but not judged properly
short delivery again, Axar pulls with style and clears the rope! He didn't have to move much and simply pulled the short ball to the wide long on boundary from the middle of the bat. Clean hit
short again, slightly slower and it's pulled to deep midwicket now
hit hard, that's going flat to deep backward square and Bopara gets his hands to it while running in but drops it! Saha pulled the short ball and found the fielders but escaped
back of length slower ball cutting in, dabbed towards deep midwicket and they sneak in two
tries to hammer the slower ball on leg, finds long on for one
comes down and drives the ball firmly into the covers, Bopara slides to his left and saves two
slow yorker on off, steered down to long on for one
fullish on the stumps, driven down straight to mid off
takes a step down and steers the low full toss off the pads to deep midwicket. That was two but Saha nearly collided with PK just after turning so denied the second
towards middle stump now, steered to midwicket for a quick single
stays a bit low as it angles in towards off stump and Axar defends it back
short of length delivery outside off is dabbed to cover point for one
pulls the short ball, gets a top edge past midwicket but it falls in no man's land and they get a single
slower through the air, chipped back to the bowler who tries to run the non-striker out, but he's in
short outside off, dabs it to short third man for one
comes down and flicks the ball to the leg side for one
that's a big wicket, has that sealed Sunrisers' win? Miller came down to smash the ball down the ground, he tried and only got a leading edge to send a very high catch for Boult at long off
quick single as Saha tries to reverse sweep the ball, gets an edge to the leg side and runs down the ground by the time Ojha picks the ball up and throws to the bowler
he's nearly bowled! Saha went back to help the slower ball to leg but got an inside edge onto the pads, that nearly went towards the stumps
on length now outside off, Saha pushes it straight to cover
back of length on middle, Miller turns it towards deep midwicket for one
angling in again towards the stumps, steered towards square leg for one
full and angled in towards middle and leg, flicked behind square on the leg side and they come back for the second
quite slow outside off as Miller comes down and then pushes it to mid off
the batsman comes down, Karn pitches it slower and slightly shorter, Marsh waits and helps it to leg for one
length delivery on off stump, pushed back to the bowler
sweeps the ball against the turn from outside off to deep backward square leg
comes down the track, lofts it down to long on but it falls well before the fielder
gogly turning towards off, pushes it towards point for one
pretty flat outside off, he slices it straight to point
widish short of a length ball, but comes slowly off the pitch, and the cut is mishit to covers
closes the face as he pushes this straight to midwicket
back of a length into the pad, rolls away square
squeezes a slowish length ball to square third man
pitched up around off, tapped towards point, who has a go at the non-striker's stumps, missed
back of a length, slight inward angle, tapped to leg
flighted again, driven neatly down to long off
opens the face and runs a tossed up ball to short third man
leans forward and tucks a full one with the turn to deep midwicket
tossed up, quite full, driven off the toe end to long off

what a waste of a wicket, it was worked in front of square, there was only one in it as deep midwicket came in, they wanted a second, Miller started and stopped, Vijay had come a long way out before he turned back, the throw was accurate on the bounce to the keeper, and he is comfortably short
he;s hit the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket, was floated up just outside off, and he slammed a big sweep
short, he powers a pull straight to deep forward square leg
length ball slanted across, pushed to extra cover
pitched up and moving in a bit, shout for leg before, but he has got some bat on it to force it behind square
big strike, Bailey has mishit to mid off, went after this full delivery, launched it to the left of the man in the position but could not clear him, easy catch
sitting up from back of a length, he swivels and forces a pull square, not able to beat the deep fielder
short of a length, just outside off, no pace to work with, tapped to point
takes two small steps again, turns it towards deep square leg and they come back for the second
pretty straight on middle stump, pushed down easily off the front foot to long on
comes down to make it a low full toss, Karn gets a hand to it but can't stop it. Single to long on
straighter and slower on off stump, Bailey blocks it back
flatter outside off, Vijay cuts it late to beat short third man but Bhuvi dives to his right to save three
bit of flight on middle, turned to the leg side for one with the wrists
full toss on the pads now, flicked easily to deep midwicket for one
short ball from Praveen, Bailey spots it early and goes back to hammer it with a pull wide of deep midwicket for four more
on length but no room this time, pushed down to mid off
beautifully timed, second four of the cover! Touch back of length outside off, Bailey went on the back foot and rolled his wrists to caress it between point and cover point for a four
slower, shorter, wider down the leg side as Bailey charged and it went for a wide
touch back of length around off, Bailey defends it back
goes down the leg side now for a aide
pitches it short of length and Bailey is quick to stay back and steer-swat it behind square on the leg side even though it didn't bounce much.
he leans forward and pushes the length delivery to mid off
back of length towards off, he defends it on off with soft hands for quick single number 3
good-length ball is pushed gently towards mid off and they take another cheeky single

slower ball on length towards the covers, they sneak in a quick single but there's a direct hit at the bowler's end and they go to the third umpire. Not out, and there was an overthrow too because the ball deflected, so they get two
bouncer on the leg side, just over the batsman so not a wide
swing and a miss! Fullish delivery outside off, Vijay chases and misses as it angles away
more swing into the batsman, yet another edge and this one goes to deep midwicket
wider outside the off stump, punched to cover point for one
136kph, bit of inswing into the batsman, Bailey defends carefully and that was about to sneak in through the gate
tries to push the ball towards off but manages an inside edge to mid on for one
swings it in slightly from length, Bailey helps it to midwicket for one

another inside edge, another wicket! Bhuvi angled the ball across Marsh outside off, he played the wrong line, trying to nudge the ball towards third man but got an inside edge and that uprooted the leg stump!
on length and outside off, pushed to cover off the front foot
draws the outside edge as it swings away, Marsh looked to play straight and the ball went to point uppishly. Fumble at point gets Marsh off the mark
length delivery swinging away from outside off, driven nicely to cover
nips it in towards the batsman now, no room and Marsh defends it back
on the other side now - length delivery swings away well outside off for a wide
this one goes down the leg side for a wide past the pads

the inswing has done it, inside edge onto the stumps! Vohra went down on a knee for the fullish delivery outside off, drove away from the body but the ball swung in and hit the leg stump after the inside edge
bangs in the short ball into the ribs, Vijay adjusts nicely and defends to the leg side for a quick single
accurate delivery on the off stump, Vohra defends it back to the bowler
leans forward now and drives the fuller ball to cover point
pushes the back of length delivery from off stump to point
beats him completely with a beautiful ball that seamed away after pitching on off and it moved away as the batsman made room to drive but missed
touch back of length outside off, pushed off the back foot to cover point
chases a wide outswinger outside off and misses it completely
makes room by going to the leg side, takes it on the full and drives it inside out from around off stump over the covers for four
swings it in again towards off and middle, Vijay defends the ball back to the bowler
angled across the off stump with the angle, no inswing, left alone
inside edge this time goes to fine leg as he tries to push the ball on off
loud appeal for lbw mainly from the keeper as the ball swung in sharply towards middle stump, turned down. The ball had good bounce as it hit him above the knee roll in the crease
similar length swinging towards the pads and Vijay this time steers the ball between short midwicket and square leg for three
bit of swing into the pads from length on middle stump, tucked straight to square leg
